name: Video Compressor: Reelwick
subtitle: Shrink videos for chat & email
shortDescription: Compress and resize videos to fit WhatsApp, email and any size limit. See the size before you start. Everything runs on your phone.
longDescription:
Reelwick is a fast video compressor and video resizer. Pick one video or a batch of up to 10, choose a target (chat 16 MB, email 25 MB, your own MB, or 1080p / 720p / 480p), see the estimated size, and compress with your phone's hardware encoder.

### Edit and Save
Trim the start and end, mute the sound, strip location data, then save or share. Your original video is never changed and nothing is uploaded.

Free to use with 2 free credits and short rewarded ads for more, or go ad-free with a monthly plan.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
